statements.attributed: sodium's high abundance and low cost
statements.quote: Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) have attracted great attention as a promising alternative to LIBs because of sodium’s high abundance and low cost .

statements.attributed: potassium's relatively high energy density resulting from the low standard reduction potential of potassium
statements.quote: The motivations triggering the study of potassium-ion batteries (PIBs) relate to the benefits of their relatively high energy density resulting from the low standard reduction potential of potassium (−2.93 V versus E0), which is close to that of lithium (−3.04 V versus E0) (Fig. 1A) ; their low cost, which is ascribed to the abundance of potassium (1.5 wt %) in Earth’s crust (Fig. 1B); and also their fast ion transport kinetics in electrolyte.

statements.attributed: potassium's low cost, which is ascribed to the abundance of potassium

statements.attributed: using aluminum foil as a current collector
statements.quote: In addition, aluminum foil can be used as a current collector in PIBs instead of the copper foil found in LIBs, which will not only notably reduce the price of the PIB but also reduce the weight of the current collector and address over-discharge problems .

statements.attributed: the diffusion coefficient of K+ is about three times larger than that of Li+
statements.quote: In addition, it has been proven that the diffusion coefficient of K+ is about three times larger than that of Li+, as investigated by ab initio molecular dynamics simulations (MDS) .

statements.attributed: potassium's poor ion diffusivity in solids could still constitute a limitation for the reaction kinetics
statements.quote: Although potassium has the weakest Lewis acidity and the smallest Stokes’ radius, leading to fast ionic conductivity in the electrolyte, its poor ion diffusivity in solids could still constitute a limitation for the reaction kinetics due to the large atomic size of K+ .

statements.attributed: graphite has ~61% volume expansion after potassiation, which is six times larger compared to that after lithiation
statements.quote: It has been demonstrated that graphite has ~61% volume expansion after potassiation, which is six times larger compared to that after lithiation .

statements.attributed: huge volume changes in the continuous cycling process undoubtedly result in pulverization and create some “dead” areas
statements.quote: Such huge volume changes in the continuous cycling process undoubtedly result in pulverization and create some “dead” areas, which are electrically isolated from the conductive agents and cause capacity fading .

statements.attributed: the solvent in the electrolyte could be readily reduced on the electrode surface
statements.quote: Owing to the low electrochemical potential of K+/K, the solvent in the electrolyte could be readily reduced on the electrode surface .

statements.attributed: the K-graphite system could go into thermal runaway at a lower temperature, but it would generate less heat compared to the commercial Li-graphite anodes
statements.quote: It was reported that the K-graphite system could go into thermal runaway at a lower temperature (100°C versus 150°C), but it would generate less heat compared to the commercial Li-graphite anodes (395 J g−1 versus 1048 J g−1) .

statements.attributed: polynanocrystalline graphite has superior cycling performance for K-ion batteries

statements.attributed: highly graphitic carbon nanocages could maintain the structural stability of the network during K+ intercalation/deintercalation
statements.quote: Thus, highly graphitic carbon nanocages were proposed to effectively maintain the structural stability of the network during K+ intercalation/deintercalation because the anisotropic cage-like structure could prevent interlayer slipping and ensure structural integrity, so that a high capacity retention of 79% at 35 C was achieved .

statements.attributed: porous carbon nanofiber electrode exhibited excellent rate capability and promising long cycling stability
statements.quote: In a recent study, a porous carbon nanofiber electrode was synthesized, and it exhibited excellent rate capability (101 mA h g−1 at 20 A g−1) and promising long cycling stability (4000 cycles) .

statements.attributed: K0.6MnF2.7 hollow nanocubes have only 1.4% volume expansion and negligible lattice parameter change
statements.quote: Liu et al. reported K0.6MnF2.7 hollow nanocubes as zero-strain material for enhanced potassium storage with only 1.4% volume expansion and negligible lattice parameter change (<1%), which made it possible to deliver over 100 mA h g−1, even after 10,000 cycles .

statements.attributed: optimized cathode material with a particle size of 20 nm could deliver a close-to-theoretical reversible capacity of 140 mA h g−1
statements.quote: A detailed comparison of the electrochemical performance of crystallite-sized Prussian white was carried out by He et al., demonstrating that the optimized cathode material with a particle size of 20 nm could deliver a close-to-theoretical reversible capacity of 140 mA h g−1 .

statements.attributed: improved exfoliation for large-scale nanosheet production
statements.quote: From our perspective, several efficient ways could be used: (i) applying well-mixed nano- and microsized materials together in a certain ratio so that nanosized particles can effectively occupy the interspaces among the microsized particles; (ii) using active materials with a secondary structure, such as micro-nanostructures, to increase the pack density; (iii) using surface coating as a promising way to alleviate the undesirable surface reactions arising from the large surface area of nanomaterials; and (iv) further developing low-cost, simple, and automatic engineering fabrication techniques

statements.quote: To address this problem, an effective and straight forward strategy is to use a soft and conductive matrix to buffer the volume changes during potassiation/depotassiation processes .

statements.attributed: amorphous carbon produced via high-shear exfoliation

statements.attributed: improved reversible capacity and cycling stability with increased nitrogen doping level
statements.quote: According to further investigations, the reversible capacity and cycling stability might be improved with an increased doping level of nitrogen .

statements.attributed: formation of C–F covalent bonds changing carbon hybridization state from sp2 to sp3
statements.quote: On the basis of the density functional theory (DFT) calculations, the C–F covalent bonds that are formed could change the carbon hybridization state from sp2 to sp3, which provides high electrical conductivity and thermodynamic stability .

statements.attributed: B-doped graphene having a large capacity, smaller diffusion energy barrier, and less structural deformation in PIBs
statements.quote: Although no experimental results have been reported as yet, DFT calculations show that B-doped graphene has a large capacity (564 mA h g−1), a smaller diffusion energy barrier, and less structural deformation in PIBs compared to SIBs .

statements.attributed: heteroatom N/O-codoping in hard carbon demonstrating good cycling performance
statements.quote: To overcome this drawback, heteroatom N/O-codoping was successfully applied in hard carbon with demonstrated good cycling performance .

statements.attributed: P/O-codoped graphene electrodes showing enhanced electrical conductivity and chemisorption of potassium ions
statements.quote: P/O-codoped graphene electrodes were investigated, and they showed enhanced electrical conductivity and chemisorption of potassium ions .

statements.attributed: cycled Bi/rGO electrodes in KFSI electrolyte having a higher surface potential than in KPF6 electrolyte
statements.quote: It was found that the cycled Bi/rGO electrodes in the potassium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (KFSI) electrolyte had a higher surface potential than that in the KPF6 electrolyte (Fig. 4, B and C), indicating higher conductivity compared to the electrodes cycled in the KPF6 electrolyte .

statements.attributed: more heterogeneous and thicker SEI layers formed in KPF6 electrolyte as cycling progressed
statements.quote: Also, in the KPF6 electrolyte, more heterogeneous and thicker SEI layers were formed as cycling progressed, thus leading to continuous consumption of the electrolyte as compared to the KFSI electrolyte .

statements.attributed: effect of salt chemistry on SEI formation
statements.quote: Also, in the KPF6 electrolyte, more heterogeneous and thicker SEI layers were formed as cycling progressed, thus leading to continuous consumption of the electrolyte as compared to the KFSI electrolyte .

statements.attributed: elastic and adhesive oligomer-containing SEI formed in diglyme-based electrolytes helping to achieve a Bi electrode with long cyclability and high coulombic efficiency
statements.quote: For example, the elastic and adhesive oligomer-containing SEI formed in diglyme-based electrolytes helps to achieve a Bi electrode with long cyclability and high coulombic efficiency (Fig. 4D) .

statements.attributed: KFSI-DME electrolyte passivating the K surface and enabling reversible K plating and stripping with a uniform and stable SEI layer
statements.quote: The KFSI-DME electrolyte as an efficient medium can passivate the K surface, enabling reversible K plating and stripping with the formation of a uniform and stable SEI layer (Fig. 4E) .

statements.attributed: K[FSA]-[C3C1pyrr][FSA] ionic liquid exhibiting low viscosity and high ionic conductivity and suppressing dendrite growth
statements.quote: A reported K[FSA]-[C3C1pyrr][FSA] (FSA = bis(fluorosulfonyl)amide; C3C1pyrr = N-methyl-N-propylpyrrolidinium) ionic liquid has been evaluated as electrolyte for PIBs and exhibited low viscosity and high ionic conductivity, which effectively suppressed dendrite growth, thus enhancing cycling stability .

statements.attributed: K1.92Fe[Fe(CN)6]0.94 cathode with 2% FEC additive in EC/DEC electrolyte exhibiting enhanced initial coulombic efficiency
statements.quote: K1.92Fe[Fe(CN)6]0.94 cathode with 2% FEC additive in the EC/DEC electrolyte in the voltage range of 2.0 to 4.3 V could exhibit enhanced initial coulombic efficiency from 60% (without FEC additive) to 90% .

statements.attributed: conventional electrodes fabricated by slurry casting onto metal foil unable to maintain structural integrity during repeated mechanical deformation
statements.quote: Conventional electrodes fabricated by a slurry casting onto metal foil cannot maintain structural integrity during repeated mechanical deformation due to the weak adhesion between the current collectors and the active materials .

statements.attributed: simple pencil drawing on filter paper fabricating a flexible anode with nearly 200% capacity improvement
statements.quote: Simple pencil drawing on filter paper was used to fabricate a flexible anode, demonstrating nearly 200% capacity improvement due to this electrode design (Fig. 5A) .

statements.attributed: PB nanocubes grown on Xuan paper via cyanotype technology maintaining discharge capacity of flexible full cells even when bent and folded during cycling
statements.quote: PB nanocubes were grown on Xuan paper via cyanotype technology, and the discharge capacity of the flexible full cells remained almost unchanged, even when they were intentionally bent and folded during cycling .

statements.attributed: reported pioneering work on room temperature K-S batteries with the conversion-type reaction mechanism (2S + 2 K+ ↔ K2S3)
statements.quote: In the case of K-S/K-Se batteries (Fig. 5, C and D), Zhao et al. reported pioneering work on room temperature K-S batteries with the conversion-type reaction mechanism (2S + 2 K+ ↔ K2S3) .

statements.attributed: reported the asymmetric nature of the discharge/charge behavior of PIBs, which may be due to the weak solvation energy and strong cation-anion electrostatic interaction between K+ and Sx2−
statements.quote: As for mechanism studies, Zou et al. reported the asymmetric nature of the discharge/charge behavior of PIBs, which may be due to the weak solvation energy and strong cation-anion electrostatic interaction between K+ and Sx2− .

statements.attributed: rationally designed a cathode separator by coating single-wall CNTs on Celgard to improve the utilization of sulfur active materials and enhance the cycle life of the K-S battery
statements.quote: Yu and Manthiram rationally designed a cathode separator by coating single-wall CNTs on Celgard to improve the utilization of sulfur active materials and enhance the cycle life of the K-S battery .

statements.attributed: investigated a K-I2 battery with highly reversible conversion among I2, KI3, and KI, and a capacity retention of 79% could be achieved after 500 cycles
statements.quote: A K-I2 battery was investigated with highly reversible conversion among I2, KI3, and KI, and a capacity retention of 79% could be achieved after 500 cycles .

statements.attributed: reported a potassium-rich iron (II) hexacyanoferrate electrode, which can supply two electrons per formula unit and deliver exceptionally high capacity (up to 120 mA h g−1) with high reversibility over 500 cycles
statements.numbers: 120 mA h g−1, 500 cycles, 65 W h kg−1, 1250 W kg−1
statements.quote: On the basis of the PB analogs, Su et al. reported a potassium-rich iron (II) hexacyanoferrate electrode, which can supply two electrons per formula unit and deliver exceptionally high capacity (up to 120 mA h g−1) with high reversibility over 500 cycles (Fig. 5F) A specific energy of ~65 W h kg−1 and a specific power of 1250 W kg−1 were achieved (Fig. 5G) .

statements.attributed: showed reversible redox behavior and could provide a potential window of 3.2 V
statements.quote: By using a potassium acetate–based water-in-salt electrolyte, the KTi2(PO4)3 electrode showed reversible redox behavior and could provide a potential window of 3.2 V, which extends the avenue for exploration of high-energy-density aqueous PIBs .

statements.attributed: adopting some expensive ionic liquid–based electrolytes
statements.quote: By adopting some expensive ionic liquid–based electrolytes or applying organic electrodes with relatively lower working voltage, the DIBs show comparatively high gravimetric energy density and excellent cycling stability, which could possibly meet the requirements of high–operating voltage and high–power density devices.

statements.attributed: the low diffusion barrier energy (0.07 eV) for K on the C3N monolayer surface implies high mobility and high rate capability for batteries
statements.quote: In the case of the C3N monolayer (with a high storage capacity of 1072 mA h g−1), the low diffusion barrier energy (0.07 eV) for K on the C3N monolayer surface implies high mobility and high rate capability for batteries .

statements.attributed: 1D diffusion pathway provided low diffusion barriers for K ion, indicating that the KVOPO4 is a promising high-rate cathode material for PIBs
statements.quote: By calculating the K ion diffusion barrier (Fig. 5I), 1D diffusion pathway provided low diffusion barriers for K ion, indicating that the KVOPO4 is a promising high-rate cathode material for PIBs .

statements.attributed: applied to reveal the solvation structure and dynamic properties
statements.quote: As for electrolyte, first-principles MDS have been applied to reveal the solvation structure and dynamic properties (Fig. 5J) .

statements.attributed: using LiNO3 to increase the interfacial stability, suppress dendrite growth, and help form a uniform SEI layer
statements.quote: Except for the wide use of FEC as additive, with successful experience in Li metal anode study, strategies such as using LiNO3 and AlCl3 to increase the interfacial stability, suppress dendrite growth, and help form a uniform SEI layer may offer new pathways for the exploration of suitable electrolyte additives for PIBs .

statements.attributed: suppress dendrite growth, avoid excess side reactions
statements.quote: It is also interesting to study alternative polymer-based electrolytes for PIBs since polymer-based electrolyte could suppress dendrite growth, avoid excess side reactions , and have better shape flexibility.
